derivedHex.name: color-accent-hover
derivedHex.mix: 23% of #BA0C2F toward black rounds to #8F0924. #8F0A24 is that mix with one green unit more.
derivedHex.reason: Hover fill of the red primary. Paper on the rest red is 5.90:1, so the label could not stay paper and clear 7:1. Paper on #8F0A24 is 8.39:1.

derivedHex.name: color-accent-pressed
derivedHex.reason: Pressed fill of the red primary. Darker than hover so the states differ. Paper on it is 9.87:1.

palette.name: color-tan
palette.role: Brand field. Logo tile. Links, speaker names, and caption emphasis on the dark surface.

palette.name: color-accent
palette.role: The accent. Star fill. Primary button fill. Badges. Error text, eyebrows, and link hover on paper.

palette.name: color-paper
palette.role: Light-mode page, field fill, and the label on a red fill. Peter's white. Not the raised card.

palette.name: color-dark
palette.role: Dark-mode page. Hero and player in both modes. Not #000000.

palette.name: color-ink
palette.role: Text on paper and on tan. Focus ring on light grounds. Never a surface.

utility.name: color-dark-tan
utility.role: Not a brand color. The 1.5px resting input border in both modes (3.49:1 on paper, 3.90:1 on white). Not a button fill. Brand tan fails that border at 2.20:1. The input's own focus border is ink. Red is the error border on light.

utility.name: color-neutral-dark-hover
utility.role: Hover fill of the neutral button on paper and tan. Not a brand color. Paper label 11.67:1.

utility.name: color-neutral-dark-pressed
utility.role: Pressed fill of the neutral button on paper and tan. Not a brand color. Paper label 13.88:1.

utility.name: color-neutral-light-hover
utility.role: Hover fill of the neutral button on #0B1215. Ink label 12.46:1.

utility.name: color-neutral-light-pressed
utility.role: Pressed fill of the neutral button on #0B1215. Ink label 10.62:1.

scheme.note: #FFFFFF is only the light raised surface. #162024 is only the dark raised surface. #2A3236 is both the dark decorative line and the neutral-dark hover; the jobs differ. The input border stays #A6783F.

alpha.name: color-line
alpha.usage: Decorative divider in light mode. Cannot bound an input.

alpha.name: color-line-dark
alpha.usage: Decorative divider in dark mode. Same hex as the neutral hover fill. Control borders on dark are #F2F2F2 or #D49A45. The input border stays #A6783F.

alpha.name: color-scrim
alpha.usage: #F2F2F2 type on a hero photograph. Minimum opacity. The old 54% #000000 overlay is 4.12:1 and fails.

alpha.name: shadow-card
alpha.usage: Card shadow. Not a contrast device.

archivo.note: Width stays 100. h3 is 800. h4 and chrome are 700. Do not use the file's 600 default or its 900 Black instance. Display is Archivo Black.

type.note: Heading separation is padding-top so it cannot collapse. First heading on a page uses padding-top 0. Display, h1, and h2 are Archivo Black 900. h3 is Archivo 800. h4 and chrome are Archivo 700. Body is Lora. No heading is 2.3x the 18px body or larger. The nav brand is the wordmark lockup, not a type style.

neutral.role: Media and utility, including Listen. Hover never inverts.

logo.geometry: regular pentagram, one point up, inner/outer = sin(18°)/sin(54°) = 0.381966
logo.meaning: California Bear Flag red star and the Texas Lone Star. No other element from either flag.
logo.clearSpace: 15% of the 512 box inside; one quarter of the star width outside a lone star; half a cap height around the wordmark

bareOnDark.note: Logo exception. No tile, no stroke. Logos are exempt from WCAG contrast.

wordmark.starArms: The horizontal through the left and right arm points sits 0.03 × cap height above the cap line.
wordmark.starTop: 0.27 × cap height above the cap line

ink.ground: light mode, and tan in both modes

onDark.ground: dark mode, and the hero in both modes

wordmark.bodyCopy: Do not insert a star glyph into a sentence.

markOnDark.use: Do not use as the site mark. Use mark-bare.svg.

markOnPaper.use: Apple-touch icon and app icon only. Not the favicon.

favicon.use: Bare red star. Overrides the paper-tile rule.
